visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a young woman's eye, which she frames with her fingers in a circular gesture. She then transitions to a medium shot, holding a laptop screen that displays a color swatch identified as 'Mocha Mousse' for the year 2025. The background consists of vertical wooden panels under bright, even studio lighting. (2) The woman is seen sitting on a white rolling office stool in a room with the same wood-paneled walls. She wears a cream-colored long-sleeve top and high-waisted brown flared trousers. She spins the chair playfully while looking at the camera. Large orange and white text overlays appear on the wall behind her. (3) A series of fashion transitions begins showcasing 'LOOK 1'. The woman adds a dark grey jacket and carries a large brown leather tote bag featuring several colorful plush keychains. She poses with her hands in her pockets, demonstrating the ensemble's silhouette against the minimalist wooden background. (4) Transitioning to 'LOOK 2', the woman appears wearing a black-and-white patterned zip-up jacket and a tan beret. She extends her arms and turns her body to highlight the movement of the jacket. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing her full upper body and movements with clear, natural focus. (5) In 'LOOK 3', she changes into a long, dark brown leather trench coat and a leopard-print beret. She strikes several dynamic poses, including turning her back to the camera to show the coat's length and belt detail. The lighting highlights the glossy texture of the leather material. (6) The final 'LOOK 4' features her in a long beige wool coat with a matching beige knitted hood and scarf. She smiles broadly, performs a small rhythmic dance move, and makes a peace sign at the camera. She continues to hold the large brown leather bag throughout the final scene.
